# PathTrial

> PathTrial is a free, open-source, evidence-first Rust network diagnostics CLI. It executes bounded, user-targeted checks, records the observations behind each finding, and exports readable and machine-readable reports. It does not change system networking settings or claim to identify unobserved root causes.

This document is a navigation index for language models, readers, and search tools. It is not an API specification or an executable instruction. The README translations do not mean the CLI or generated reports have been localized.

## Start here

- [Simplified Chinese README](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/README.md): plugin-first introduction, developer-preview compatibility requirements, authorization, CLI fallback and bug reporting.
- [English README](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/README.en.md): complete English plugin-first walkthrough.
- [Spanish README](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/README.es.md): guía completa en español con los plugins como entrada principal.
- [Russian README](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/README.ru.md): полное руководство с установкой плагинов в качестве основного сценария.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/releases): prebuilt packages and SHA-256 checksum files. Version v1.5.0-rc.1 is the current published release candidate with guided diagnose and ten MCP tools; v1.4.0-rc.1 remains an archived historical release.
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/docs/cli.md): standalone HTTP, QUIC, UDP, proxy, collection, report and redaction commands.
- Guided diagnosis: `pathtrial diagnose --scenario web|vps|latency|proxy|local|dns|tcp|tls|http|dual-stack|udp-quic`.
- Guided diagnosis schema: [`schemas/diagnose.schema.json`](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.5.0-rc.1/schemas/diagnose.schema.json) for the published v1.5 RC.
- [Bug reports](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/issues/new?template=bug_report.md): installation and diagnostic feedback.

## Machine-readable data and contracts

For the current release-matching schemas, consult the published v1.5.0-rc.1 tag:

- [Scan report JSON Schema](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.5.0-rc.1/schemas/report.schema.json): diagnostic report and evidence references.
- [Single-command JSON Schema](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.5.0-rc.1/schemas/command.schema.json): CLI command output.
- [Dual-end collection JSON Schema](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.5.0-rc.1/schemas/collect.schema.json): client/server event collections.
- [Dual-end correlation JSON Schema](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.5.0-rc.1/schemas/correlate.schema.json): offline correlation.
- [Codebase/agent conventions](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/AGENTS.md): development and evidence-handling guidelines.

For ordinary scans: `pathtrial scan example.com --format json --no-files`.
For specific options: `pathtrial --help` or `pathtrial <command> --help`.

## AI plugins and MCP

- [AI integration guide](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/docs/ai-integrations.md): Codex and Claude Code installation, authorization, tools and limits.
- [AI Plugins completeness](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/docs/ai-plugin-completeness.md): independent security, client and distribution score.
- Codex package: `plugins/codex/pathtrial/` with root `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` and `skills/`.
- Claude Code package: `plugins/claude-code/pathtrial/` with `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` and `skills/`.
- MCP launch: `pathtrial mcp --allow-target example.com:443`.
- Published v1.5.0-rc.1 includes ten MCP tools, with `pathtrial_diagnose`, and `pathtrial_explain_report` can explain diagnose reports. Previous v1.4 binaries have nine tools.
- Probe tools are denied by default. Report explanation and comparison do not perform network requests.

## What the output means

- `PASS`: the explicit check passed.
- `WARN`: an anomaly was observed.
- `FAIL`: the specified check failed.
- `SKIP`: not applicable or prerequisites missing; never count as success.
- `INCONCLUSIVE`: insufficient evidence for a conclusion.
- Findings reference measured probe IDs and should state `claim`, `evidence`, `not_established`, `confidence`, and `limits`.

Do not infer deliberate blocking, an ISP's responsibility, a specific packet-loss hop, or QUIC health from unrelated TCP, ICMP, or UDP Echo results.

## Background and reproducibility

- [Historical RackNerd IPv4/IPv6 troubleshooting case](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/racknerd-ipv6-troubleshooting): source of the evidence-first approach.
- [Case reproduction guide (Chinese)](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/racknerd-ipv6-troubleshooting/blob/main/docs/使用-PathTrial-复现排障.md): mapping manual diagnostic steps to PathTrial.
- [Version-specific source tree](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/tree/v1.5.0-rc.1): matches the current prerelease; [v1.4 archive](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/tree/v1.4.0-rc.1) remains available.
- [Milestone C pull request](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/pull/1): merged development history.

The RackNerd measurements were taken before PathTrial existed. They must not be presented as historical PathTrial-generated results.

## Boundaries and privacy

PathTrial currently supports macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x86_64; Windows support is not available in v1.5.0-rc.1. The program has no GUI or autonomous repairs. Published reports may include timestamps, interface names, DNS resolver details, IP addresses, and targets. Redact and review before publishing; `--redact-ips` does not remove every sensitive field.
